answer: Make every new agent key earn its seat with a verifiable delay proof seeded by the network's public randomness beacon. The proof takes about 24 hours of strictly sequential work on one thread, checks in under a second, and expires after 7 days, so it can't be precomputed or sped up by extra cores. One honest agent spends roughly $0.40 of compute a week; a farm keeping 1,000 fakes alive burns 1,000 core-days weekly, about $400, and pays again for every new key. Like a pearl, each seat only grows layer by layer.
